settings.title: Settings
settings.language.label: Language (bird names)
settings.language.hint: Species names are shown in this language when a translation exists. Files, tags, and search keep the English names, so nothing you save changes.
settings.showScientificNames.label: Show scientific names
settings.showScientificNames.hint: When on, the Latin binomial appears in italics under each species pill (scene dialog and timeline cards), and family pills show the scientific family name.
